From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@brightpay.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Objective slate: owner concord + exec clearance

Team — attaching the Q1 objectives slate (v3) and the leadership sign-off PDF. I want to lock this down for the quarter and route to exec sign-off by end of day Friday (01/12). High level: this is intentionally lean — three top-level objectives with owners and primary outcomes so we can be crisp in QBR. Please do the following by EOD Thursday (01/11):

- Review your owned objectives and confirm the primary success metric (highlighted column in the spreadsheet).
- Flag any scope or resourcing concerns inline in the sheet (use comments).
- Confirm you can commit to the cadence below (weekly ops sync + biweekly owner review).

Quick summary of the slate (see sheet for details):
1) Improve API latency and reliability — Owner: Kimberly — Target: 95th perc p95 < 120ms on hosted ops; reduce error-rate to <0.1% on steady-state load.
2) Optimize serving unit economics — Owner: Sergio — Target: 20% reduction in per-token cost on core routes via batching/quantization and cache policies.
3) Expand enterprise readiness for private deployments — Owner: Neha — Target: complete SOC2 gap remediations + pilot with BrightPay by EOM.

Attachments: Q1_objectives_draft_v3.xlsx (master), Q1_leadership_signoff_form.pdf (for Rachel to e-sign).

As a reminder: once we have owner concord (internal signoff) I'll route the signoff PDF to Rachel for exec clearance and then publish the slate to the org QBR packet.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Objective slate: owner concord + exec clearance

Rafael — thanks for pulling this together. Quick read and a few inline notes I added to the spreadsheet:

- Latency objective: can we specify p99 guardrail for the top 10% of traffic? I'll add a second metric column so we track both p95 (primary) and p99 (guardrail).
- I proposed a small buffer on the baseline token-rate assumption (+5%) — should reduce rework if Q1 demand is bursty.

On BrightPay: Elena, could you confirm the pilot window constraints? If they need a specific API SLA we should call that out in the pilot success criteria.

Happy to iterate — I can own the tracking template for weekly ops syncs.

-Kim
Senior Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

- Increased baseline token-rate assumption by 5% (Kim).
- Inserted compliance success criteria and runbook milestones (Neha).

- Sergio: confirm that 20% cost reduction remains achievable with the new baseline assumptions (reply by EOD Thu 01/11).
- Kim: confirm ops cadence and tracking template (reply by EOD Thu 01/11).
- Neha: confirm pilot regulatory scope or ask Elena for clarifying note.

Attachments: Q1_leadership_signoff_form.pdf (please open — I will populate the top-level summary and then send to Rachel to sign).

Once I get the confirmations I'll populate the signoff PDF and route to Rachel via DocuSign. If we miss the Thursday window we'll need to delay routing until Monday next week which will compress the QBR packet timeline.

-Rafael
